confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two cost-of-living aggregators found by web search (MyLifeElsewhere and Traveltables). Traveltables was last updated in 2023, so these are only a rough guide. I raised the beer anchor above the aggregated figures of about USD 1.7-2.2 because those look like shop or local prices, while a draft in a tourist-area restaurant is usually around 90-120 THB. I estimated cocktail and wine from typical Samui ratios to beer and general knowledge, so they are less certain. Wine is expensive because Thailand taxes imported wine heavily. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates and were not checked against live listings. July is high season, which pushes room rates up. The FX figure is the RBA 4pm rate for 18 November 2026, as reported in a search summary that cited the official RBA exchange-rates page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are benchmarked against Phuket and other Thai island resorts. Koh Samui is about 10-20% above the Thai national average and similar to or slightly above Phuket for restaurants and accommodation.
